# PRODUCT ANCHOR

<!-- Generated by sdk-web <anchorPhase> on 2026-11-02 from [root/ai/] specs -->

App: AB Recording Studio website (public, static, v1)

Visitors can:
- Browse musicians the studio has worked with and open each profile (bio, credits, links)
- Read the studio background (story, rooms and gear, team)
- See the upcoming festival: dates, venue, lineup (free entry, no tickets)
- Email the studio at binauanders@gmail.com (mailto, no form)

Tabs: Home | Musicians | Background | Festival | Contact

Primary entities: StudioInfo, Musician, MusicianCredit, AboutSection, Festival, LineupSlot
No login, no admin in v1.
